# Docs screenshots (#6823)

The website-down guide's first steps with their screenshots, drawn with the docs' own stylesheet
(`Docs/Static/css/style.css`) around the pictures in
`Docs/Static/images/screens/<language>/`:

- `guide-de-1280.png`: German, 1280 px, light.
- `guide-fa-390-dark.png`: Persian (right to left), 390 px, dark.

The screenshots themselves are drawn by `cd packages/E2E && npm run docs-screens`
(`packages/E2E/DocsScreens/README.md`).
